$ /bin/bash -c curl -fsSL https://docs.mcpjam.com/sdk/reference/run-suite-file.md -o run-suite-file.md && rg -n 'mode|toolCall|sch
emaVersion|render' run-suite-file.md | head -45 && npx mcpjam cloud eval validate --help
29: mode: "byok",
49:| `inference.mode` | `"auto"` | `"auto"`, `"byok"` or `"mcpjam"`; see [Inference](https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/local-evals.md#in
ference). |
71:| `cases` | Per case: effective model and rail, configured iterations and threshold, the evaluator-config hash, judge state, im
port evidence, per-iteration evidence (lifecycle status, task verdict, evaluator error, attributed refusal, tool calls, policy blo
cks, scores, stage chain) and the case's row of the decision. |
74:| `report` | The validated `eval-local-run` structured report; pass it to `renderStructuredRunJson`, `renderStructuredRunJUnitX
ml`, `renderStructuredRunHtml`, or `formatLocalEvalRunSummary`. |
80:Input that cannot run and environments that cannot be set up throw `SuiteFileRunError` with a stable `code`, a `phase` (`valida
tion`, `setup`, `execution`, `reporting`) and a `category`. Validation and setup refusals are thrown **before any model or tool ca
ll**. A refusal that found concrete problems also lists every one found at that stage in `details.problems`; other errors carry on
ly their message, so treat `problems` as optional.
82:One error comes after execution: `REPORT_INVALID` (phase `reporting`, category `integrity`) means the cases ran, model calls we
re made and may have been billed, but the run's own report failed validation, so no result is returned. Retrying repeats that infe
rence.
87:| `unsupported` | Direct `toolCall` steps, widget/render/discovery assertions, gating tool-result and latency assertions, gatin
g judges; organization AI-key policy refused the model (`AI_POLICY_REFUSED`) |
Usage: mcpjam cloud eval validate [options]
Validate a local eval suite file offline — no auth, no network unless --project
is passed (0 valid, 1 contract-invalid or unresolved reference, 2
unreadable/oversize/malformed)
Options:
--file <path> Suite file to validate, .yaml or .json (or - for
stdin)
--project <id-or-name> Also resolve the file's deterministic tool references
against this project's live servers. Opt-in: without
it the command stays entirely offline.
-h, --help display help for command
[exit=0; signal=None; timeout=unrecorded]
